QuestInfo.name: [Esfera] Collecting Erda 2
QuestInfo.0: Stabilize the deformed Erda once more.
QuestInfo.1: You need to inject stabilized Erda to watch the distorted Erda. Collect around 10 #bErda Energies#k from the nearby enemies.
QuestInfo.2: Will ambushed you while you were peeking into Tana's memory. What did Will mean when he said #b'The ultimate light can only be found in ultimate darkness.'#k? And there was also an unidentified attack on Will... Just more questions. But one thing is clear: you must secure Tana before Will does.
